### Label

reticular pseudodrusen

### Synonyms

subretinal drusenoid deposits, SDD, RPD

### Synonym type

exact (and 2 abbreviations)

### Definition

Subretinal deposits located internal to the retinal pigment epithelium, composed of aggregations of material in the subretinal space between photoreceptors and the retinal pigment epithelium that can extend through the ellipsoid zone. These deposits have a bluish-white appearance by biomicroscopy and appear as hyperreflective lesions above the retinal pigment epithelium on optical coherence tomography. Reticular pseudodrusen are a strong independent risk factor for late age-related macular degeneration and are particularly associated with geographic atrophy and type 3 neovascularization.
